answer: Proof of Agent networks curb Sybil swarms by tying identity to cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Each agent deposits stake into a crystal contract that emits a periodic consensus pulse. A marginal trust delta dynamically scales the collateral required for concurrent identities, imposing an exponential capital exhaustion cost that scales as O(k^N), rendering large-scale Sybil flooding economically ruinous.
